contract: Both arms execute the complete UnifiedResearchAgent without a finite candidate override. Each five-task stream restores the entire KnowledgeLibrary through JSON at every boundary. One apparatus seed is constant across a stream; public task specs are identical across instrument and response mechanism changes. Learners receive controls, channel price and purchased observations; no formula or delay is supplied. Each probe resets all control and instrument history. Independent terminal trajectories are collected only after the complete stream, using only selected prediction channels. Observation, measurement and compute costs include source learning, revision and return. Final prediction measurement cost is reported separately. Old and new runtimes load the same frozen apparatus implementation.
